descriptor: Exact 64-World Completion-Lattice Adjudication, Missingness-Assumption-Free Holm Invariance, Frozen-Branch Robustness, Six-Tau Partial-Identification Closure & Zero-Call Cross-Task Measurement-Law Verdict
central_question: Do all 64 P55-admissible completions of the six unresolved Gemini stopping times produce the same frozen P53 primary Holm decisions and the same primary cross-task measurement-law branch?

scope.source: P55 canonical artifact plus frozen P53/P51 code and baseline
scope.authority: Primary Gemini stopping-time transport/factorization layer only. Zero-shot allocation-policy transfer is not reopened because its complete response matrices remain unavailable.

completion_lattice.rule: Enumerate the Cartesian product exactly; no probability, weighting, missingness model or ignorability assumption is assigned to worlds.

frozen_analysis.tests: Exactly the six P53 Gemini primary tests: 3 historical P51→fresh-task correlations + 3 leave-one-task-out fresh-task correlations.
frozen_analysis.permutation_null: Reuse P53 fixed 5000 vertex-label permutations and seeds through src/p53_cross_task.py.
frozen_analysis.multiplicity: Reuse the original six-test Holm FWER=0.05 procedure unchanged.
frozen_analysis.factorization: Reuse P53 task + representation + task×representation sums-of-squares decomposition unchanged.

invariance_courts.holm: For each of six tests report raw-p, Holm-p and rejection ranges across 64 worlds; call Holm-invariant only if the rejection vector is identical in all worlds.
invariance_courts.branch: Count exact branch frequencies across all 64 worlds; call branch-identified only if exactly one branch occurs.
invariance_courts.coordinate_influence: For each unresolved tau coordinate compare branch/rejection supports under its low versus high value; a coordinate is branch-influential only if changing that bit can alter the branch in at least one matched background world.
invariance_courts.factorization: Report exact ranges of task, representation and interaction shares over all worlds.

verdict_logic.law: One branch occurs in all 64 worlds and it is CROSS_TASK_MEASUREMENT_DIFFICULTY_LAW_PRIMARY_ONLY.
verdict_logic.null: One branch occurs in all 64 worlds and it is NO_CROSS_TASK_MEASUREMENT_LAW_PRIMARY_ONLY or TASK_INTERACTION_DOMINATES_PRIMARY_ONLY.
verdict_logic.holm_only: All six Holm rejection decisions are invariant but branch differs because factorization branch conditions differ.
verdict_logic.sensitive: More than one primary branch or more than one Holm rejection vector occurs.

killed: Worst/best-case missing-data sensitivity analysis is prior art.
Finite completion enumeration is not itself novel.
Holm robustness under perturbations is not itself novel.
novelty_kill.surviving_candidate: A fully prospective hosted-inference recovery chain in which raw technical incompleteness is reduced to a finite stopping-time completion lattice and the original scientific branch is adjudicated exactly over every admissible world without missingness assumptions or additional model calls.

frozen_rules: No world weighting or missingness probability.
No P53 statistic, permutation seed, alpha, Holm rule, factorization or branch ordering changes.
P53 and P54 historical TECHNICAL_HOLD receipts are not rewritten; P56 is a new primary-estimand closure stage.
No provider-internal or neural mechanism claim.
